evidence.issue: Requested process is not necessarily the content supervised by the physical routing target
evidence.facts: Native auxiliary targets encode each reasoning relation separately, while the original caption enters only contextual request memory in the global heads. VP010/VP025 cached reasoning omits or drifts from parts of the requested process.
evidence.scope: A concrete conditioning/supervision mismatch; does not prove the sole cause of all quality losses.

evidence.issue: Explicit request path has modest content sensitivity in the trained R10A reader
evidence.scope: Same16 CPU intervention of explicit request words only. Other reasoning states still contain original request/image context. No claim that the whole model ignores text or that a particular percent change proves quality.

evidence.facts: VP038 reasoning describes roller transfer and coating. R10A normal/noC have equalSA4 but PC3/4; original video evidence documents structural defects. VP017 has coherent requested reasoning yet normal/noC SA2/3.
evidence.scope: Existing same-checkpoint interventions; input-only repair cannot account for every failure.

evidence.issue: A fixed16 improvement is not evidence of full40 acceptance
evidence.facts: R10A full40 needs +12 SA score points, +2 PC points and +5 joint passes to reach current minima; R15D fixed16PC3.875 but other24PC3.375. These are aggregate ordinal-score gaps, not predicted improvements.

design_work: Prioritize request-grounded physical memory formation: preserve literal entities, states, requested relations, ordered transitions and final outcomes; reasoning supplies physical evidence instead of replacing the requested scenario. Static/stability/optical phenomena remain valid; do not force motion.

Keep semantic correspondence between what addresses a physical update and what its value writes. Independent physical Q remains part of the redesign; native textQKVO stay frozen. R10A/R1/R9 mechanisms are references, not compulsory topology.

The running native-video-response probe tests one downstream execution mechanism only. It does not recover information already lost before the physical write and will not automatically become the formal R15E design.
Use current complete40, relevant recent controls and useful historical evidence to finalize one coherent architecture and training design. Do not launch a formal400 job merely to enumerate switches.

Do not reuse the withdrawn temporal-loss proposal or assume that lower C cosine proves useful physics. Keep all scoring protocols, shared inputs and existing outputs intact; no hand edits of benchmark reasoning to maximize scores.
